topics.summary: Bundled plugin-layer defaults, including canonical app shortcut verbs.
topics.body:
# Defaults

This bundled plugin owns Flash's default plugin-layer behavior. Today it registers the canonical app-shortcut verbs:

- `flash app_save` - Cmd-S
- `flash app_print` - Cmd-P
- `flash document_open` - Cmd-O
- `flash window_new` - Cmd-N

Each verb uses the manifest's `keystrokes` table, so the host translates it directly into a core keystroke action without round-tripping through the plugin process. Users who want a raw host-only experience can disable this plugin with `[plugins] disabled = ["defaults"]`.
